contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [SAL AVG P M TR P XII / XIII IMP VIII COS V P P], S C ; D/ [M COMMODVS ANT P FELIX AVG BRIT]

A copper-alloy sesterius of Commodus (AD 180-192) (Reece period 9). Reverse legend reads [SAL AVG P M TR P XII / XIII IMP VIII COS V P P], S C. Reverse shows Salus seated left feeding snake at altar. Mint is Rome (AD 186-188). See RIC Vol.III, p.424 & 425, nos.504 & 515. Obverse legend reads [M COMMODVS ANT P FELIX AVG BRIT]. Obverse shows Laureate head right. Die axis is 12 o'clock. Weight is…
